name: agent-remote-control
description: Cursor + VS Code remote control via Telegram, MCP, and hooks

scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rimraf dist && rimraf dist
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.package:vscode-extension: pnpm --filter agent-remote-vscode-extension run build && pnpm --filter agent-remote-vscode-extension run prepackage && pnpm --filter agent-remote-vscode-extension run package
scripts.package:cursor-extension: pnpm --filter agent-remote-cursor-extension run build && pnpm --filter agent-remote-cursor-extension run package
